evals.prompt: We have a .NET 9 API in src/ with xUnit tests in tests/, and our ci.yml already uploads a coverage.cobertura.xml as artifact 'coverage'. I want the same nightly test-coverage agent we have in DT-Geminex for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the .NET stack and the existing artifact, asks the interview forms with pre-filled defaults, previews the plan, then generates test-coverage.md, the selector script and its test, and config.json with a cobertura source; runs node --test and gh aw compile.

evals.prompt: set up a gh-aw workflow that writes jest tests every night for our react app in apps/web (yarn 4, no coverage in CI yet) and opens draft PRs only touching *.test.tsx
evals.expected_output: Notices there is no coverage source, recommends 'generate' with jest json-summary, sets pathPrefix/include for apps/web, restricts allowed-files to test globs, network includes node, and installs dependencies in setup steps rather than in the sandbox.

evals.prompt: Can you copy the idea of DT-Geminex test-coverage.lock.yml to our Python + Go monorepo? Python uses pytest-cov, Go uses go test -coverprofile, both run in build.yml.
